hypothesis: At least one Q90 typed-AST operator subgroup (linear_mean or nonlinear pairwise_interaction plus conditional_gate) improves Q7+Q80 prior-only meta-quality baseline by at least 0.005 MAE in historical Blind OOS, with 20-target moving-block 95% CI lower bound above zero and Holm-adjusted one-sided block-sign-flip p<0.05.
estimand: Next-target mean normalized percentile across 1,023 Q7 quintet_score formulas; not winning-number or ticket prediction.
primary_endpoints: Q90 linear_mean state MAE gain over Q7+Q80
Q90 nonlinear interaction/gate state MAE gain over Q7+Q80
reproduction_control: Q7+Q80+all-seven-Q90-family model must reproduce Q141-C5 M2 metrics on all three splits within 1e-10.

models.M0: Q7 rolling-50 mean percentile plus Q80 rolling-50 equal-family state
models.M2: M0 plus Q90 pairwise_interaction_I4 and conditional_gate_G4 state
models.M3: M0 plus all seven Q90 operator-family states; reproduction control

walkforward.validation_blind: coefficients frozen after Discovery; features prior-only

limitations: Historical Blind OOS already exposed; exploratory only.
Q90 behaviour ledger is a fixed 700-formula sample from 330,429 ASTs.
Only 3,286 aligned target rows; source cutoffs differ.
Holm covers two A26 tests only, not full Q00-Q141 family.
